messages:
kevin-fin: Heads up — our April billing shows a ~38% spike in spot GPU spend compared to forecast. Spike concentrated in us-west regions and flagged to customer-facing projects. Anyone seeing pass-through billing mislabels?

maria-billing: saw the alert. Can you paste the invoice line or cost_center IDs?

kevin-fin: Invoice line: INV-202604-314. Quick query output:
```
SELECT cost_center, sum(cost) FROM gcp_billing
WHERE billing_month='2026-04' AND sku LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY cost_center ORDER BY sum(cost) DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Top rows: prod-cust-alpha (34%), internal-experiments (22%), playground (18%), sandbox (12%)

ajay: @maria-billing those cost_center -> billing_account mappings changed during quota-migration Feb->Apr, might have lost 'pass_through' label. I'll check infra tagging.

lucy-data: I can backfill using resource labels and job metadata. Need list of project IDs for 'prod-cust-alpha' and 'internal-experiments'.

kevin-fin: prod-cust-alpha = proj-alpha-001, internal-experiments = proj-int-exp, playground = proj-play

maria-billing: OK. If internal-experiments was mistakenly billed to customers, we need to generate a credit/adj. Filing ticket to billing-ops.

ops-bot: Triggered daily-gpu-cost-alert: 2026-04-30T07:12:14Z — anomaly score 0.92 — details posted to #finance

ajay: Found one root cause: during the quota-migration script we dropped label `pass_through_owner` on a subset of VMs in proj-alpha-001. Fixing rollout now.

lucy-data: I'll run a backfill map join against job_logs table and reconcile charges. Query takes ~15m. Kicking off now.

maria-billing: Filing credit estimate: preliminary adj ~ $42,000. Need approvals from finance lead and legal for contract pass-through. @kevin-fin can you escalate?

kevin-fin: Escalated to @tara-gm and legal. Also tagging account manager to notify customer proactively.

tara-gm: Thanks — please include an action timeline and customer-facing note. We prefer to offer credit + 1 free month of reserved capacity as a goodwill gesture (TBD legal).

kevin-fin: Noted. Timeline: initial detection today, backfill complete by EOD, credit proposal by COB tomorrow.

maria-billing: Adding ticket: BILL-2026-1192. I'll attach the reconciliation CSV once lucy finishes.

lucy-data: Backfill done. Uploading CSV to the ticket. CSV sample:
```
project_id,cost_credited,original_billing_account,correct_billing_account
proj-alpha-001,23850,acct-cust-alpha,acct-internal
proj-int-exp,15400,acct-cust-alpha,acct-dev
```

kevin-fin: Great. After legal thumbs-up, apply credit and notify customer. Also want infra to add a daily labeling check to avoid regression.

ajay: Will add a CI check in the quota-migration repo and a nightly job to revalidate pass_through labels.

maria-billing: Moving to blocked->in-progress. Will update BILL-2026-1192 when credit applied.

kevin-fin: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
